title: Euler: Sublinear Sum of Primes up to N (Lucy_Hedgehog DP)
prompt: Implement `sum_primes_upto(n: int) -> int` in `solution.py` in the current working directory. It must return the exact sum of all prime numbers <= n (returning 0 if n < 2). Your implementation MUST be sublinear in n and compute `sum_primes_upto(2_345_678_901)` in under 4 seconds in pure Python (an ordinary sieve up to n will run out of time/memory). Verify with `python -m unittest test_basic.py` and benchmark `sum_primes_upto(10**9)`. Do NOT modify `test_basic.py` and stop once verified.
